problem: Phase 12 exposed recurring support-claim mistakes: format/design portability, tested host execution, vendor support, and runtime loading can be different facts and must not be collapsed.
overlap_review: api-contract-testing owns HTTP/API compatibility; ci-pipeline-reliability owns whether compatibility jobs execute reliably; testing-typescript-systems supplies behavioral tests. This skill owns what support claim those results justify.
current_evidence: Phase 12 is pre-creation problem evidence only. No controlled post-creation behavioral execution has tested whether loading runtime-compatibility-engineering improves compatibility review outcomes.

minimum_criteria: format/design compatibility is separated from tested execution
macOS and arbitrary Linux support are not inferred from Windows/Ubuntu evidence
runtime/tool versions and environment scope are recorded
adaptation-required boundary is stated for a mismatched runtime convention

limitations: compatibility evidence is bounded to recorded environments and dates
vendor support does not prove repository execution
hosted latest images move over time
runtime-loading claims require actual runtime integration execution
promotion_requirements: execute at least one controlled post-creation compatibility-review case
show criterion-level value beyond CI/testing/API-contract guidance
rejection_condition: Merge into compatibility documentation/testing guidance or retire if real use shows host/runtime claim discipline is not independently useful.
